## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Get a single note by ID with its full content, including auto-restack configuration (autoRestackAfterHours), Buffer cross-post channels (bufferChannelIds), and any per-channel Buffer post overrides (bufferChannelPosts: custom text and attachments for a channel).

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `noteId` | `string` | Yes | The note ID |
